about: A first intent's latency (FLUIDITY-LEAD-16, 6 Nov 2026; H2 'tooltips on demand'): from a hover or a Tab onto a control to its popup on screen, on a cold load (as soon as the trigger is on screen) and once the page has settled (Home useful, 2.5 s, and the popup's script in, or 4 s). The control is the sidebar's 'New project' tooltip on /app/home at 1280 (surfaces.mjs --only intent --device desktop), at 1x and 4x; each intent has a tab of its own.

A hover's popup waits the trigger's delay (Tooltip's 400 ms) by design: its target is that delay and a few frames; OverDelayMs is what is left over it. A Tab shows at once. Wire: the same cold intents with every script asked for from the intent on held one round trip (the harness's rtt, 150 ms), since this harness serves scripts from localhost.
Report only: these rows say what an intent costs; none fails a run.

hoverColdMs.source: A pointer's first move onto the trigger as soon as it is on screen, to the tooltip placed on screen.

hoverColdOverDelayMs.source: hoverColdMs less the trigger's 400 ms delay: what a cold hover waits beyond the design's own wait.

tabColdMs.source: A real Tab onto the trigger (from the focusable before it) as soon as it is on screen, to the tooltip placed on screen. Focus shows a tooltip at once.

hoverIdleMs.source: The same hover once the page has settled.

tabIdleMs.source: The same Tab once the page has settled.

hoverColdWireMs.source: hoverColdMs with scripts asked for from the intent on held one round trip (150 ms).

tabColdWireMs.source: tabColdMs with scripts asked for from the intent on held one round trip (150 ms).
